# Define the Generator
def generator(params, x):
    h1 = jnp.maximum(0, jnp.dot(x, params['W1']) + params['b1'])
    h2 = jnp.maximum(0, jnp.dot(h1, params['W2']) + params['b2'])
    out = jnp.tanh(jnp.dot(h2, params['W3']) + params['b3'])
    return out

# Define the Discriminator
def discriminator(params, x):
    h1 = jnp.maximum(0.2, jnp.dot(x, params['W1']) + params['b1'])
    h2 = jnp.maximum(0.2, jnp.dot(h1, params['W2']) + params['b2'])
    out = jnp.sigmoid(jnp.dot(h2, params['W3']) + params['b3'])
    return out

    real_loss = -jnp.mean(jnp.log(discriminator(params, real_data)))
    fake_loss = -jnp.mean(jnp.log(1 - discriminator(params, fake_data)))
    return real_loss + fake_loss

from optax import adam, cross_entropy_with_integer_labels, apply_updates

# Define the Encoder
class Encoder(nn.Module):
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, initial_carry):
        embedding = nn.Embed(num_embeddings=20, features=32)(x)
        lstm = nn.LSTMCell(features=64)
        _, (hidden, cell) = lstm.init(initial_carry, embedding)
        return hidden, cell

# Define the Decoder with Attention
class Decoder(nn.Module):
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, encoder_outputs, hidden, cell):
        embedding = nn.Embed(num_embeddings=20, features=32)(x)
        attention = nn.Dense(10)
        attention_combine = nn.Dense(32)
        lstm = nn.LSTMCell(features=64)
        fc_out = nn.Dense(20)

        attention_weights = jax.nn.softmax(jnp.sum(attention(jnp.concatenate([embedding, hidden], axis=-1)), axis=-1), axis=-1)
        context_vector = jnp.einsum('bti,btj->bij', attention_weights, encoder_outputs)

        combined = jnp.tanh(attention_combine(jnp.concatenate([embedding, context_vector], axis=-1)))
        lstm_out, (hidden, cell) = lstm.init(initial_carry=(hidden, cell), inputs=combined)
        output = fc_out(lstm_out)
        return output, hidden, cell

import jax.numpy as jnp
from flax import linen as nn
from flax.training import train_state
import optax
import math

class PositionalEncoding(nn.Module):
    def setup(self, d_model, max_len=5000):
        pe = jnp.zeros((max_len, d_model))
        position = jnp.arange(0, max_len)[None, :]
        div_term = jnp.exp(jnp.arange(0, d_model, 2) * (-jnp.log(10000.0) / d_model))

        pe = pe.at[:, 0::2].set(jnp.sin(position * div_term))  # Even indices
        pe = pe.at[:, 1::2].set(jnp.cos(position * div_term))  # Odd indices

        pe = pe[None, :, :]  # Shape: [1, max_len, d_model]
        self.register_buffer('pe', pe)

    def __call__(self, x):
        seq_len = x.shape[1]
        return x + self.pe[:, :seq_len]


class MultiHeadSelfAttention(nn.Module):
    def setup(self, embed_dim, num_heads):
        assert embed_dim % num_heads == 0, "Embedding dimension must be divisible by number of heads"

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = embed_dim // num_heads

        self.qkv_proj = nn.Dense(3 * embed_dim)
        self.out_proj = nn.Dense(embed_dim)

    def __call__(self, x):
        B, T, D = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv_proj(x)  # Shape: (B, T, 3*D)
        qkv = qkv.reshape(B, T, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv[0], qkv[1], qkv[2]  # Each is (B, num_heads, T, head_dim)

        scores = (q @ k.swapaxes(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(self.head_dim)  # (B, num_heads, T, T)
        attn_weights = jax.nn.softmax(scores, axis=-1)
        attn_output = attn_weights @ v  # (B, num_heads, T, head_dim)

        attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, T, D)
        return self.out_proj(attn_output)


class FeedForward(nn.Module):
    def setup(self, embed_dim, ff_dim):
        self.linear1 = nn.Dense(ff_dim)
        self.relu = nn.relu
        self.linear2 = nn.Dense(embed_dim)

    def __call__(self, x):
        return self.linear2(self.relu(self.linear1(x)))


class TransformerEncoderLayer(nn.Module):
    def setup(self, embed_dim, num_heads, ff_dim):
        self.attn = MultiHeadSelfAttention(embed_dim, num_heads)
        self.ffn = FeedForward(embed_dim, ff_dim)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)

    def __call__(self, x):
        x = x + self.attn(self.norm1(x))
        x = x + self.ffn(self.norm2(x))
        return x


class TransformerModel(nn.Module):
    def setup(self, vocab_size, embed_dim, num_heads, num_layers, ff_dim, output_dim):
        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(jnp.zeros((1, 1, embed_dim)))

        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, embed_dim)
        self.pos_encoding = PositionalEncoding(embed_dim)
        self.layers = [TransformerEncoderLayer(embed_dim, num_heads, ff_dim) for _ in range(num_layers)]
        self.output_proj = nn.Dense(output_dim)

    def __call__(self, x):
        x = self.embedding(x)
        x = self.pos_encoding(x)

        # Prepend CLS token to the sequence
        cls_tokens = self.cls_token.broadcast_to((x.shape[0], -1, -1))
        x = jnp.concatenate((cls_tokens, x), axis=1)

        for layer in self.layers:
            x = layer(x)

        return self.output_proj(x[:, 0])  # Use CLS token for classification
